title: Summarize every group with new messages
what: Summarizes, one by one, each group allowed for the AI that has new messages since the last summary (the first time it takes the last 24 hours). While the app is open, groups with new messages are summarized in the background at most once every 2 hours (turn off in Settings › Telegram › Auto-summarize Briefing). A group whose AI access is about to expire or has expired shows a "Renew for 30 days" line in Briefing.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)

Click "Summarize new messages · N groups" to summarize the groups with new messages one by one (the button only shows when there are unsummarized messages); the middle of the page shows which group the AI is reading

how: While summarizing: the "Summary" button at the top right becomes a round red stop button (with an n/N group count for several groups); click it to cancel midway

how.t: To summarize one group: hover the group in the sidebar's "Groups · Briefing" section and click ✦
Change the model / effort just for Briefing under the Briefing assistant's question box
Click the circular "Check again" icon to look for new messages

keys: briefing summarize all groups run all stop check again new messages summarize one group model effort

title: Briefing assistant: ask the AI about every group
what: The right column (on phones: the "AI assistant" tab; on desktop hidden by default so the list is wider: click "Ask AI" at the top right to open it, X in the panel to hide it, the chat is kept and the app remembers your choice; available once at least one group is summarized) is a chat about the latest summary of every group: what to do first today, who is waiting on you, blockers, writing a standup… The AI reads only the summaries, no further Telegram messages. Answers can be copied or sent to Saved Messages. Each sourced point carries a group · #message chip (hover to see the item) and the same buttons as Briefing's rows: "Reply", "Create ticket", "Check code" (BE questions, decisions / changes; Dev role). Questions to ask come ready per group, each message with a copy button and "Ask in Q&A": that group's Q&A opens with the question filled in, tag who you ask, then send. Under the latest answer a few "Ask next" questions fill the box when clicked. Each chat is saved under AI Agent › Briefing in this browser.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
On desktop, click the "Ask AI" button (robot) at the top right
Click a suggestion card, or type a question in the "Ask about every group…" box and press Enter

how: Click the stop button while the AI is answering to cancel; the trash icon at the top of the panel clears the chat
keys: ask ai briefing what to do today standup blockers risks who is waiting on me all groups chat ai

title: To do across all groups (For you, To confirm, To-dos…)
what: Gathers questions needing confirmation, to-dos, decisions and changes from the latest summary of every group into one list with filter tabs. The "Needs you" tab shows only items asked of / assigned to you (by your YouTrack name; PO/PM for the PO role). Tick the circle to mark an item handled (saved on this machine). Items where you replied to the original message on Telegram (sent from the app or from Telegram) move to handled by themselves, marked "You replied". To-dos without a ticket are checked against YouTrack: a similar ticket shows "may already exist …", otherwise a prominent "No ticket · Create" button appears. Items nobody resolved in the last summary stay, labeled "open since …".

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
Pick a tab: For you, To confirm, To-dos, Settled, Changes (the number next to it = unhandled items)
Click "Reply" / "Create ticket" right under an item, or click the group name to open the group's summary
Click the circle at the start of a line to mark it handled; "Handled N" at the bottom to review / unmark

keys: for you decided needs confirmation questions awaiting confirmation briefing pending decisions to-dos handled tick mark todo replied auto reply youtrack no ticket suggest create ticket duplicate

title: Groups in the sidebar: filter, summarize, open, remove
what: The sidebar's "Groups · Briefing" section lists the groups: yellow dot = new messages, green = up to date, number = open items (it drops as you mark them handled). Click a group to see only its items; hover a group for ✦ summarize the group, ↗ open the Summary page, 🗑 remove from Briefing (confirm box "Remove group from Briefing?"; the AI stops reading the group and its summary is deleted; add it back with "Add group"). The Copy button at the top right copies every summary as one Markdown.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
Click a group in the "Groups · Briefing" section to see only its items; click "Briefing" to see everything again
Hover a group and click ↗ to open the group's Summary page
Hover a group, click the trash can, then click "Remove group" in the confirm box
Click "Copy all" to copy the Markdown of every group

keys: copy all briefing markdown new messages group chips filter by group status remove group delete from briefing revoke sidebar groups briefing open items

title: Send the briefing to Saved Messages
what: Sends the unhandled items of every group (needs confirmation, to-dos, decided, changes) as one message to your Saved Messages on Telegram, to read on your phone. Ask AI answers can be sent too.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
Click the paper plane icon "Send to Saved Messages" at the top right

how: Or in an Ask AI answer, click "Send to Saved Messages"
keys: saved messages send telegram phone briefing send to myself

title: Add a group that never tagged you to Briefing
what: Pick any Telegram group (even one that never tagged you) to open its Summary; click Allow there and the group joins Briefing. Groups not yet allowed for the AI come first in "Add group" (at the end of the sidebar's "Groups · Briefing" section).

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
Click "Add group" at the end of the sidebar's "Groups · Briefing" section
Type in the "Search Telegram groups…" box

how: Click a group name ("AI not allowed yet" groups are on top)

how.t: On the Summary page, click "Allow" so the group shows up in Briefing
